t: Death Of Mrs. M.G. Krylov, Russian Resident

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. ____
8th/d/d,/
Date November 17, 19 37

Subject Anonymous letter containing allegations regarding circumstances of
death of Mrs. M.G. Krylov, local Russian resident.
Made by D.S.I. Irokofiev. Forwarded by 〔此处转录不清〕

Attached herewith together with a translation I
forward an anonymous letter which was delivered to me on 16-11-37
It was posted on the morning of November 13 at Post Office Branch
No 18 situated at the corner of Avenue Joffre and Route Cardinal
Mercier. The letter contains allegations to the effect that
Mrs M.G.KRYLOV, Russian opera singer of repute, who died suddenly
on November 11, met her death at the hands of local agents of the
"CHEKA".

Enquiries at the Vital Statistics Office, F.H.D.,
show that Mrs Maria Grigorievna Krylov, Soviet citizen, died at
her residence, No 673 Weihaiwei Road, Apt. 28, and that in the
death certificate issued by Dr. E. Sostheim (German) the cause
of death is stated as" Apoplectic insult (cerebri);" The deceased's
remains were cremated on November 13 on instructions of the lo-
cal Soviet Consular Authorities.

Of the three persons referred to in the letter in
question as agents of the "Cheka", V.V.KLARIN is a prominent mem-
ber of the local branch of the Mladorossy Party which was often
denounced by the rightist elements of Russian emigrants as a
pro-Soviet organization.

Mrs A.PRIBYTKOFF, a local Russian actress, was also
mentioned by the same elements in Shanghai in connection with
alleged pro-Soviet leanings, while Mrs BERSHADSKY who is also
popular in local musical circles, did not come to the notice of
the Municipal Police in connection with any political activities.

It appears from the correspondence which was pub-
lished in the local Russian newspapers that shortly prior to her
death Mrs Krylov severed her connections with the Russian Opera
Company of which Klarin is one of the main organizers. It also

报告

1937年11月17日

事由：关于本地俄籍居民 M.G. 克雷洛夫夫人（Mrs. M.G. Krylov）死亡情况的匿名信，信中载有相关指控。
由警探 Irokofiev 呈报。经由〔此处转录不清〕转呈

现随函附上于1937年11月16日送达本人的一封匿名信及其译文。
该信于11月13日上午投递至位于霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）与梅神父路（Route Cardinal Mercier）转角处的第18号邮政支局。信中指控称，享有盛誉的俄国歌剧演唱家 M.G. 克雷洛夫夫人于11月11日突然去世，系死于当地“契卡”（CHEKA）特工之手。

经向工部局卫生处生命统计办公室查询，结果显示：苏联公民玛丽亚·格里戈里耶夫娜·克雷洛夫（Maria Grigorievna Krylov）夫人死于其住所，即威海卫路673号28室；德国医生 E. Sostheim 出具的死亡证明书中，死因记载为“脑卒中（Apoplectic insult (cerebri)）”。死者遗体已于11月13日遵照当地苏联领事当局的指示火化。

在上述匿名信中被指称为“契卡”特工的三人中，V.V. 克拉林（V.V. KLARIN）是当地“青年俄罗斯党”（Mladorossy Party）分支的 prominent 成员，该组织常被俄侨右翼分子谴责为亲苏组织。

当地俄籍女演员 A. 普里贝特科夫夫人（Mrs. A. PRIBYTKOFF）也被上海同样的右翼分子提及，指称其有亲苏倾向；而同样在当地音乐界颇受欢迎的 B. 贝尔沙茨基夫人（Mrs. BERSHADSKY）并未因任何政治活动引起工部局警务处的注意。

从当地俄文报纸刊登的通信来看，克雷洛夫夫人在去世前不久断绝了与俄罗斯歌剧团的联系，克拉林是该剧团的主要组织者之一。此外

pages.en:
Translation from Russian

Mrs M.KRYLOVA DIED.

It is known that at the time of her death her enemies -
agents of the G.P.U. and terrorists from the CHEKA in the
persons of V.KLARIN, A.PRIBYTKOVA and BERSHADSKAYA were
present at her bedside. She had quarrels with these per-
sons,especially with V.KLARIN whom she intended to expose
as a terrorist sent to Shanghai from Moscow. The name of
V.KLARIN always made Mrs Krylova shudder. Her quarrel in
the opera company compelled her to take steps in order to
expose Klarin. She met her death at the hands of agents
of the CHEKA because she had broken off any relations with
agents of the Comintern and the latter were afraid of being
exposed.

AN ARTIST. ( female)

俄文译文

M. 克雷洛娃夫人逝世。

据悉，在她去世时，她的敌人——格别乌（G.P.U.）特工和契卡恐怖分子，即 V. 克拉林、A. 普里贝特科娃和贝尔沙茨卡娅——就在她的病床前。她与这些人发生过争吵，尤其是与 V. 克拉林，她曾打算揭露他是从莫斯科派往上海的恐怖分子。V. 克拉林的名字总是让克雷洛娃夫人感到战栗。她在歌剧团的争执迫使她采取行动以揭露克拉林。她之所以死于契卡特工之手，是因为她断绝了与共产国际特工的一切关系，而后者害怕被揭露。

一位女艺术家。

NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS, November 17, 1947

Mme. Maria Grigorievna Krilova
One of the most beautiful and touching services ever held in the chapel of the International Funeral Directors took place yesterday afternoon when the many friends and admirers of the late Madame Maria Grigorievna Krilova gathered to pay their last respects. The deceased died suddenly at the age of 45 on Thursday at her residence on Weihaiwei Road and her death came as a distinct shock to everyone.
The civic memorial service was in charge of the Soviet authorities. In a hushed silence during which every head was bowed in silent tribute, the Shanghai Municipal Orchestra under the direction of Maestro Paci softly played a funeral dirge, after which Mr. Shushlin, gave a short speech. Above the casket, which was almost completely covered with multi-coloured cut flowers, hung four large wreaths from the Shanghai Municipal Orchestra, Russian Ballet, Soviet Community of Shanghai and Freda and the U.S. Marine Band. Many other flowers were received from friends.
The deceased was for several years singing in the Grand Opera of U.S.S.R. and was professor of voice in the National Conservatory of China here. On the eve of her death she was planning to return to Russia and re-enter opera at the earliest possible time. Shanghai audiences heard her sing for the last time in the light opera at the Canidrome last week. As a mark of respect the opera "Carmen" was postponed until after the funeral. The remains will be cremated and sent to Moscow.

《字林西报》，1947年11月17日

玛丽亚·格里戈里耶夫娜·克里洛娃夫人
昨天下午，在国际殡仪馆的小教堂内举行了最为优美动人的仪式之一，已故玛丽亚·格里戈里耶夫娜·克里洛娃夫人的众多朋友和仰慕者聚集于此，致以最后的敬意。死者于周四在其威海卫路的住所突然去世，享年45岁，她的死讯令所有人深感震惊。
这场市民追悼会由苏联当局主持。在一片肃穆的寂静中，众人低头默哀致敬，上海工部局乐队在指挥帕奇（Maestro Paci）的带领下轻柔地演奏了一首葬礼挽歌，随后舒什林先生（Mr. Shushlin）发表了简短讲话。几乎完全被五彩鲜花覆盖的灵柩上方，悬挂着来自上海工部局乐队、俄罗斯芭蕾舞团、上海苏联侨民社区以及弗雷达（Freda）和美国海军陆战队乐队的四个大型花圈。还有许多鲜花来自各界朋友。
死者曾在苏联大剧院演唱数年，并在此担任国立音乐专科学校的声乐教授。在去世前夕，她正计划返回俄罗斯，并尽早重返歌剧舞台。上周，上海观众在跑狗场（Canidrome）上演的轻歌剧中最后一次听到她的歌声。为示尊重，歌剧《卡门》的演出推迟至葬礼之后举行。遗体将火化并运往莫斯科。

女艺术家。
